verses.original: Καὶ ἐδόθη μοι κάλαμος ὅμοιος ῥάβδῳ λέγων Ἔγειρε καὶ μέτρησον τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai edothē moi kalamos homoios rhabdō legōn Egeire kai metrēson ton naon tou Theou kai to thysiastērion kai tous proskynountas en autō
verses.literal: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told Go and measure the temple of God and the altar and count the number of worshipers there
verses.literalPt: E FOI-ME dada uma cana semelhante a uma vara; e chegou o anjo, e disse: Levanta-te, e mede o templo de Deus, e o altar, e os que nele adoram.

verses.original: καὶ τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἔξωθεν τοῦ ναοῦ ἔκβαλε ἔξωθεν καὶ μὴ αὐτὴν μετρήσῃς ὅτι ἐδόθη τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν πατήσουσιν μῆνας τεσσεράκοντα καὶ δύο
verses.transliteration: kai tēn aulēn tēn exōthen tou naou ekbale exōthen kai mē autēn metrēsēs hoti edothē tois ethnesin kai tēn polin tēn hagian patēsousin mēnas tesserakonta kai dyo
verses.literal: But exclude . . . the courtyard outside the temple Do not measure it because it has been given over to the nations and they will trample the holy city for 42 . . . . . . months
verses.literalPt: E deixa o átrio que está fora do templo, e não o meças; porque foi dado às nações, e pisarão a cidade santa por quarenta e dois meses.

verses.original: καὶ δώσω τοῖς δυσὶν μάρτυσίν μου καὶ προφητεύσουσιν ἡμέρας χιλίας διακοσίας ἑξήκοντα περιβεβλημένοι σάκκους
verses.transliteration: kai dōsō tois dysin martysin mou kai prophēteusousin hēmeras chilias diakosias hexēkonta peribeblēmenoi sakkous
verses.literal: And I will empower . . . my two witnesses and they will prophesy for 1,260 . . . . . . days clothed in sackcloth
verses.literalPt: E darei poder às minhas duas testemunhas, e profetizarão por mil duzentos e sessenta dias, vestidas de saco.

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν αἱ δύο ἐλαῖαι καὶ αἱ δύο λυχνίαι αἱ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Κυρίου τῆς γῆς ἑστῶτες
verses.transliteration: Houtoi eisin hai dyo elaiai kai hai dyo lychniai hai enōpion tou Kyriou tēs gēs hestōtes
verses.literal: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth
verses.literalPt: Estas são as duas oliveiras e os dois castiçais que estão diante do Deus da terra.

verses.original: καὶ εἴ τις αὐτοὺς θέλει ἀδικῆσαι πῦρ ἐκπορεύεται ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτῶν καὶ κατεσθίει τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν καὶ εἴ τις θελήσῃ αὐτοὺς ἀδικῆσαι οὕτως δεῖ αὐτὸν ἀποκτανθῆναι
verses.transliteration: kai ei tis autous thelei adikēsai pyr ekporeuetai ek tou stomatos autōn kai katesthiei tous echthrous autōn kai ei tis thelēsē autous adikēsai houtōs dei auton apoktanthēnai
verses.literal: If anyone wants to harm them fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies In this way anyone who wants to harm them must be killed
verses.literalPt: E, se alguém lhes quiser fazer mal, fogo sairá da sua boca, e devorará os seus inimigos; e, se alguém lhes quiser fazer mal, importa que assim seja morto.

verses.original: οὗτοι ἔχουσιν τὴν ἐξουσίαν κλεῖσαι τὸν οὐρανόν ἵνα μὴ ὑετὸς βρέχῃ τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς προφητείας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχουσιν ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων στρέφειν αὐτὰ εἰς αἷμα καὶ πατάξαι τὴν γῆν ἐν πάσῃ πληγῇ ὁσάκις ἐὰν θελήσωσιν
verses.transliteration: houtoi echousin tēn exousian kleisai ton ouranon hina mē hyetos brechē tas hēmeras tēs prophēteias autōn kai exousian echousin epi tōn hydatōn strephein auta eis haima kai pataxai tēn gēn en pasē plēgē hosakis ean thelēsōsin
verses.literal: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy and power - to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish
verses.literalPt: Estes têm poder para fechar o céu, para que não chova, nos dias da sua profecia; e têm poder sobre as águas para convertê-las em sangue, e para ferir a terra com toda a sorte de pragas, todas quantas vezes quiserem.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν τελέσωσιν τὴν μαρτυρίαν αὐτῶν τὸ θηρίον τὸ ἀναβαῖνον ἐκ τῆς ἀβύσσου ποιήσει μετ’ αὐτῶν πόλεμον καὶ νικήσει αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀποκτενεῖ αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan telesōsin tēn martyrian autōn to thērion to anabainon ek tēs abyssou poiēsei met’ autōn polemon kai nikēsei autous kai apoktenei autous
verses.literal: When the two witnesses have finished their testimony the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them and will overpower and kill them
verses.literalPt: E, quando acabarem o seu testemunho, a besta que sobe do abismo lhes fará guerra, e os vencerá, e os matará.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ πτῶμα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῆς πλατείας τῆς πόλεως τῆς μεγάλης ἥτις καλεῖται πνευματικῶς Σόδομα καὶ Αἴγυπτος ὅπου καὶ ὁ Κύριος αὐτῶν ἐσταυρώθη
verses.transliteration: kai to ptōma autōn epi tēs plateias tēs poleōs tēs megalēs hētis kaleitai pneumatikōs Sodoma kai Aigyptos hopou kai ho Kyrios autōn estaurōthē
verses.literal: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city figuratively called Sodom and Egypt where their Lord was also crucified
verses.literalPt: E jazerão os seus corpos mortos na praça da grande cidade que espiritualmente se chama Sodoma e Egito, onde o seu Senhor também foi crucificado.

verses.original: καὶ βλέπουσιν ἐκ τῶν λαῶν καὶ φυλῶν καὶ γλωσσῶν καὶ ἐθνῶν τὸ πτῶμα αὐτῶν ἡμέρας τρεῖς καὶ ἥμισυ καὶ τὰ πτώματα αὐτῶν οὐκ ἀφίουσιν τεθῆναι εἰς μνῆμα
verses.transliteration: kai blepousin ek tōn laōn kai phylōn kai glōssōn kai ethnōn to ptōma autōn hēmeras treis kai hēmisy kai ta ptōmata autōn ouk aphiousin tethēnai eis mnēma
verses.literal: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb
verses.literalPt: E homens de vários povos, e tribos, e línguas, e nações verão seus corpos mortos por três dias e meio, e não permitirão que os seus corpos mortos sejam postos em sepulcros.

verses.original: καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς χαίρουσιν ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς καὶ εὐφραίνονται καὶ δῶρα πέμψουσιν ἀλλήλοις ὅτι οὗτοι οἱ δύο προφῆται ἐβασάνισαν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: kai hoi katoikountes epi tēs gēs chairousin ep’ autois kai euphrainontai kai dōra pempsousin allēlois hoti houtoi hoi dyo prophētai ebasanisan tous katoikountas epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: And those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them and celebrate and send one another gifts because these two prophets had tormented them
verses.literalPt: E os que habitam na terra se regozijarão sobre eles, e se alegrarão, e mandarão presentes uns aos outros; porquanto estes dois profetas tinham atormentado os que habitam sobre a terra.

verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ τὰς τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ ἥμισυ πνεῦμα ζωῆς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσῆλθεν ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ φόβος μέγας ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τοὺς θεωροῦντας αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai meta tas treis hēmeras kai hēmisy pneuma zōēs ek tou Theou eisēlthen en autois kai estēsan epi tous podas autōn kai phobos megas epepesen epi tous theōrountas autous
verses.literal: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered . . . the two witnesses and they stood on their feet and great fear fell upon those who saw them
verses.literalPt: E depois daqueles três dias e meio o espírito de vida, vindo de Deus, entrou neles; e puseram-se sobre seus pés, e caiu grande temor sobre os que os viram.

verses.original: καὶ ἤκουσαν φωνῆς μεγάλης ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λεγούσης αὐτοῖς Ἀνάβατε ὧδε καὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐθεώρησαν αὐτοὺς οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ēkousan phōnēs megalēs ek tou ouranou legousēs autois Anabate hōde kai anebēsan eis ton ouranon en tē nephelē kai etheōrēsan autous hoi echthroi autōn
verses.literal: And the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying Come up here And they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them
verses.literalPt: E ouviram uma grande voz do céu, que lhes dizia: Subi para aqui. E subiram ao céu em uma nuvem; e os seus inimigos os viram.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐγένετο σεισμὸς μέγας καὶ τὸ δέκατον τῆς πόλεως ἔπεσεν καὶ ἀπεκτάνθησαν ἐν τῷ σεισμῷ ὀνόματα ἀνθρώπων χιλιάδες ἑπτά καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἔμφοβοι ἐγένοντο καὶ ἔδωκαν δόξαν τῷ Θεῷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai en ekeinē tē hōra egeneto seismos megas kai to dekaton tēs poleōs epesen kai apektanthēsan en tō seismō onomata anthrōpōn chiliades hepta kai hoi loipoi emphoboi egenonto kai edōkan doxan tō Theō tou ouranou
verses.literal: And in that hour there was a great earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed Seven thousand were killed in the quake and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven
verses.literalPt: E naquela mesma hora houve um grande terremoto, e caiu a décima parte da cidade, e no terremoto foram mortos sete mil homens; e os demais ficaram muito atemorizados, e deram glória ao Deus do céu.

verses.original: Ἡ Οὐαὶ ἡ δευτέρα ἀπῆλθεν ἰδοὺ ἡ Οὐαὶ ἡ τρίτη ἔρχεται ταχύ
verses.transliteration: Hē Ouai hē deutera apēlthen idou hē Ouai hē tritē erchetai tachy
verses.literal: The second woe has passed Behold the third woe is coming shortly
verses.literalPt: É passado o segundo ai; eis que o terceiro ai cedo virá.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ ἕβδομος ἄγγελος ἐσάλπισεν καὶ ἐγένοντο φωναὶ μεγάλαι ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ λέγοντες Ἐγένετο ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ κόσμου τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ βασιλεύσει εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων
verses.transliteration: Kai ho hebdomos angelos esalpisen kai egenonto phōnai megalai en tō ouranō legontes Egeneto hē basileia tou kosmou tou Kyriou hēmōn kai tou Christou autou kai basileusei eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn
verses.literal: Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet and loud voices called out in heaven The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ and He will reign forever and ever
verses.literalPt: E o sétimo anjo tocou a sua trombeta, e houve no céu grandes vozes, que diziam: Os reinos do mundo vieram a ser de nosso SENHOR e do seu Cristo, e ele reinará para todo o sempre.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι οἱ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καθήμενοι ἐπὶ τοὺς θρόνους αὐτῶν ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi eikosi tessares presbyteroi hoi enōpion tou Theou kathēmenoi epi tous thronous autōn epesan epi ta prosōpa autōn kai prosekynēsan tō Theō
verses.literal: And the twenty-four . . . elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God
verses.literalPt: E os vinte e quatro anciãos, que estão assentados em seus tronos diante de Deus, prostraram-se sobre seus rostos e adoraram a Deus,

verses.original: λέγοντες Εὐχαριστοῦμέν σοι Κύριε ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν ὅτι εἴληφας τὴν δύναμίν σου τὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἐβασίλευσας
verses.transliteration: legontes Eucharistoumen soi Kyrie ho Theos ho Pantokratōr ho ōn kai ho ēn hoti eilēphas tēn dynamin sou tēn megalēn kai ebasileusas
verses.literal: saying We give thanks to You O Lord God Almighty the One who is and who was because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Graças te damos, Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso, que és, e que eras, e que hás de vir, que tomaste o teu grande poder, e reinaste.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ ἔθνη ὠργίσθησαν καὶ ἦλθεν ἡ ὀργή σου καὶ ὁ καιρὸς τῶν νεκρῶν κριθῆναι καὶ δοῦναι τὸν μισθὸν τοῖς δούλοις σου τοῖς προφήταις καὶ τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ τοῖς φοβουμένοις τὸ ὄνομά σου τοὺς μικροὺς καὶ τοὺς μεγάλους καὶ διαφθεῖραι τοὺς διαφθείροντας τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: kai ta ethnē ōrgisthēsan kai ēlthen hē orgē sou kai ho kairos tōn nekrōn krithēnai kai dounai ton misthon tois doulois sou tois prophētais kai tois hagiois kai tois phoboumenois to onoma sou tous mikrous kai tous megalous kai diaphtheirai tous diaphtheirontas tēn gēn
verses.literal: The nations were enraged and Your wrath has come The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets as well as the saints and those who fear Your name both small and great and to destroy those who destroy the earth
verses.literalPt: E iraram-se as nações, e veio a tua ira, e o tempo dos mortos, para que sejam julgados, e o tempo de dares o galardão aos profetas, teus servos, e aos santos, e aos que temem o teu nome, a pequenos e a grandes, e o tempo de destruíres os que destroem a terra.

verses.original: Καὶ ἠνοίγη ὁ ναὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ὤφθη ἡ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένοντο ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταὶ καὶ σεισμὸς καὶ χάλαζα μεγάλη
verses.transliteration: Kai ēnoigē ho naos tou Theou ho en tō ouranō kai ōphthē hē kibōtos tēs diathēkēs autou en tō naō autou kai egenonto astrapai kai phōnai kai brontai kai seismos kai chalaza megalē
verses.literal: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple And there were flashes of lightning rumblings peals of thunder an earthquake and a great hailstorm
verses.literalPt: E abriu-se no céu o templo de Deus, e a arca da sua aliança foi vista no seu templo; e houve relâmpagos, e vozes, e trovões, e terremotos e grande saraiva.
